info.title: Partner API
info.description: Lets another service create accounts, sign people in, plan, build and publish apps, make games with the Game Studio, and read AI usage on their behalf. See docs/partner-api.md for the full guide.

servers.description: Same server (keys set to "this server only")
Public address (keys with an IP allowlist)

tags.name: games
tags.description: The Game Studio: make, build, steer, change, publish and download games for a person.

tags.name: ai
tags.description: Apps' own AI keys (published apps never use the platform's AI).

tags.name: sharing
tags.description: "Share a copy" links and copies (each person gets their own, independent copy).

post.description: Needs the users permission. An email address that belongs to an account outside the key's scope is refused with 409 email_taken; accounts are never taken over.

post.summary: Propose an app plan for a person to review
post.description: Same checks as the studio: the person's AI allowance must not be used up (planning itself isn't charged) and plans are limited to 30 an hour per person. Takes up to 6 reference images (`images`), or a `referenceId`. Refused with 422 build_not_allowed when the build rule applies.

example.prompt: A booking site for a small yoga studio

409.description: idempotency_in_progress: a request with this Idempotency-Key is still running.

post.summary: Build an app for a person
post.description: Charges one AI action to the person (refunded if the build fails). Poll GET /runs/{runId}, or configure a webhook on the key. Takes up to 6 reference images (`images`), or a `referenceId`. Refused with 422 build_not_allowed when the build rule applies.

example.prompt: A booking site for a small yoga studio

409.description: idempotency_in_progress: a request with this Idempotency-Key is still running.

post.summary: Make a game for a person and start its build
post.description: Charges one AI action to the person (given back when the build delivers nothing). Follow it with GET /games/{id} or /events, or the game.* webhooks. Refused with 422 build_not_allowed by the build rule (no game is left).

example.prompt: A cat platformer: collect 10 fish to open the door

post.summary: Make a "Share a copy" link for an app, design or game
post.description: Like the studio's Share dialog. The thing's owner must be in the key's scope. At most 20 active links per thing.

get.summary: The links and the copies made of an app, design or game

delete.description: The link stops working at once; copies already made stay with the people who made them.

post.summary: Make a person's own copy of an app, design or game
post.description: The copy belongs to `userId`, starts unpublished on a fresh address and never carries the original's AI or payment keys, signing keys, store accounts, domains, push credentials, webhook secrets or published versions. The person's plan limits apply (403 plan_limit).

partnerKey.description: A partner key (nk_live_...), made under Admin → Partner API or Reseller → Partner API.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Send a unique value (a UUID) to make retries safe: a repeat within 24 hours returns the first answer (with Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of doing it again.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed in the current window.

RequestId.description: Quote this when reporting a problem.

BadRequest.description: invalid_request, invalid_json, invalid_idempotency_key; with reference images also images_not_supported, image_type, too_many_images, image_fetch_failed, references_not_found.

Unauthorized.description: unauthorized: missing, unknown or revoked key.

Forbidden.description: network_not_allowed, permission_denied, suspended, user_suspended, seats_full, plan_limit.

NotFound.description: not_found: no such id, or it is outside the key's scope.

RateLimited.description: rate_limited or ai_quota_exceeded. Retry-After says when to try again (rate_limited).

ImageTooLarge.description: image_too_large: a reference image is over 5 MB.

BuildNotAllowed.description: build_not_allowed: the platform doesn't build apps similar to NullKode LLC's products (docs/partner-api.md, "The build rule"). The message is the sentence to show the person, in their language. (On POST /builds and POST /plan, idempotency_key_reused also answers 422.)

error.message: I can't build apps similar to NullKode LLC's NullKode platform, IgniteUps.ai, or any AI tools built by NullKode LLC.

plan.description: Only used when the account is created.

paths.description: The same pages as paths, to use as "to" in POST /sso.

to.description: A path on this site (starting with a single /).

previous.description: A plan from a previous run, with `change`.

images.description: Up to 6 reference images of how the app should look. Reading them is one AI action. Counted in the Idempotency-Key's request.

referenceId.description: A `referenceId` from an earlier plan or build, to reuse its images (instead of `images`).

plan.description: A reviewed plan (from a plan run) to build exactly.

images.description: Up to 6 reference images of how the app should look. Reading them is one AI action. Counted in the Idempotency-Key's request.

referenceId.description: A `referenceId` from an earlier plan or build, to reuse its images (instead of `images`).
When images were sent: their id, for revisions and the build.

message.description: Latest progress, in the person's language.

plan.description: Plan runs: the proposed plan (pass it to POST /builds).

id.description: Send as referenceId to reuse the images.

references.description: The run's reference images, if any.

errorCode.description: On error: build_not_allowed when the build rule stopped the run, else failed.

refunded.description: A failed build's AI action was given back.

notice.description: Show this to the person: add your own AI key (in their language; null for the platform owner).

ai.description: AI features of the app or plan: published apps use their own AI key.

games.description: This month's Game Studio builds and changes in the key's scope (part of `used`).
This month's Game Studio builds and changes (part of `used`).

WebhookEvent.description: POSTed to the key's webhook address when a build it started ends. Headers: X-NK-Event, X-NK-Delivery, X-NK-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<raw body>")>.

ReferenceImage.description: A reference image (concept art, a sketch, a screenshot, a mood board): exactly one of `url` or `data`. At most 5 MB; PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF (checked from the file's bytes). Shrunk to at most 1600 px and kept privately for 7 days after its last use.

url.description: A public https:// link to the image.

data.description: The image: a data: URL or plain base64.

VisualBrief.description: What the AI saw in the reference images.

FeatureCounts.description: How many of the game's planned features are in each status.

how.description: What the feature does, in a sentence.

status.description: planned = not built yet; built = built, no usable test; passing / failing = its test's newest result.

test.description: The feature's test: {start, setup?, steps: [key presses and waits], expect: [read-only expressions]}. Null when the AI's test couldn't be used.

note.description: What the step did, in a sentence.

error.description: Only on a step that failed.

added.description: Added while running (for notes, or by the checks).

kind.description: playtest-fix / feature-fix: added by the checks; change: a change made at the check-in.

features.description: Ids of the features this step builds.

phase.description: The build phase the step belongs to (1 = the playable slice). Null for a build without phases.

status.description: `review`: a full game's build waits for the owner at its check-in (after the first playable part): POST /games/{id}/continue or /changes.

step.description: The step running now (1-based), or the number of finished steps when none runs.

error.description: On error: what went wrong, in the person's language.

refunded.description: The AI action was given back (nothing was delivered).

buildPhase.description: A full game's build phases: the phase running now (or next) and how many there are. Null for a build without phases.

aiActions.description: AI actions this job used: the build, plus one for Keep building or for changes at a check-in.

features.description: What a change did to the feature list (ids). Null for a build.

GameJob.description: A build or a change of a game.

ok.description: The headless check passed (null = not run).

screenshotPath.description: Under the API's base: GET it with the key (image/webp).

status.description: `review`: waiting for the owner at the check-in after the first playable part (see `review`).

app.description: The app the game is published as.

screenshot.description: The newest version with a screenshot; `path` is under the API's base (GET it with the key).

workspace.description: The game's workspace (needs the person signed in).

GameCard.description: A game as lists show it.

note.description: On a note sent while building: where it stands.

plan.description: Null until the plan is made.

brief.description: genre, pitch, coreLoop, controls, levels, winLose, artStyle, audio.

visual.description: The art direction: camera, palette [{hex, role}], shapes, materials, lighting, density, ui, motion.

content.description: The full game's content from the brief.

playMinutes.description: Estimated minutes for a first play-through.

phases.description: The build's phases (empty for a build without phases).

review.description: Set while the game waits at a check-in (status `review`).

brand.description: A promotional game's branding, or null.

prompt.description: The game. Required unless images are sent.

locale.description: The game's language and its progress messages' (default: the person's).

prompt.description: The change. Required unless images are sent.

wait.description: Wait up to 30 seconds for the immediate answer.

reply.description: The immediate answer (null when it took longer than the wait).

hostedOnly.description: Usable in games on the platform, never in a download (= not redistributable).

game.description: GameCard on game.step.completed and game.published; Game on the others.

GameWebhookEvent.description: POSTed to the key's webhook address for games built with the key. Same headers and signature as WebhookEvent.

GameReview.description: A full game's check-in: the build stopped after a phase and waits for the owner.

jobId.description: The waiting build (the same job carries on).

phase.description: The phase just finished (1 = the playable slice).

phases.description: How many phases the build has.

message.description: The check-in message in the chat: what's playable now, the phases to come, the question. In the person's language.

question.description: "Do you want me to keep building in this direction, or make some changes?" in the person's language.

continueCost.description: AI actions POST /games/{id}/continue uses: 1, or 0 when the build came back to the check-in after a failure in a part that had delivered steps.

GameBrandInput.description: A promotional game's branding. Every field is optional.

AiStatus.description: Whether the app's AI is ready: published apps use their own AI key (docs/ai-in-apps.md).

platformOwner.description: The owner is a platform admin: their apps may use the platform's AI.

needsKey.description: usesAi and no key and not the platform owner: the AI parts don't work until a key is added.

AiConnection.description: An app's AI connection. The key itself is never returned.

keyHint.description: The key's first and last 4 characters.

apiKey.description: Write-only. Omit to keep the saved key.

test.description: Try the connection once after saving.

source.description: How it got on the list.

last.description: The newest test result in words.

ShareKind.description: What is shared. An app made from a design or a game is shared as that design or game.

ShareLink.description: A "Share a copy" link. Anyone in the owner's workspace who opens `url` (signed in) can make their own copy.

includeData.description: Apps: copies get sample rows from the tables the app's public pages show (never accounts, passwords, visitors' own entries or private tables).

expiresInDays.description: null or absent: no end date.

CreateCopy.description: Either `token` (a share link's) or `kind` and `id` (anything in the key's scope).

userId.description: Who gets the copy (in the key's scope).

includeData.description: With kind and id only; a link carries its own choice.

path.description: Studio path, usable as `to` for POST /sso.

post.summary: A build started with this key ended
A game built with this key: a step was saved, the build ended, stopped or reached its check-in, or it was published
